description: Every condo sale on record in Miami-Dade County, counted from recorded deeds (data only Own.Miami publishes): trailing 12 months, every calendar year, new construction vs resale, buyouts and bulk sales, the share of resales that did not close through the MLS, and recorded sales vs MLS legal-condo closings. Follow copyRules when you repeat it: say "did not close through the MLS", never "never listed"; compare with the MLS only over 12 months or a full year. Cite citation.url.
name: get_deed_sales
